description:
🤝 *Proud Moment for our Club!* 🤝

On 22nd Oct, our President *Rtn. Rajesh Sahu* exchanged Rotary Flags with the *President & District Governor of the Rotary Club of Las Vegas, USA* 🇮🇳🤝🇺🇸

A symbol of international friendship and Rotary's vision of connecting the world!

Thank you Rotary Club of Las Vegas for this wonderful fellowship.

Service Above Self
